role: Declared deterministic certification limits. A numeric limit is not a claim that every assembled device has been qualified to it.

marine_motion.qualification: retained marine envelope plus selected acceleration-jerk limit; MOVING requires both attitude and displacement span on complete moving windows; all-time primitive, jerk and both excitation memberships must be certified

attitude_excitation.rule: for every physical moving episode I and every complete window W of duration T_E contained in closure(I): gravity-direction span(W) >= theta_E; windows crossing physical rest boundaries belong to transition; isolated zero-rate instants do not split moving episodes
attitude_excitation.numerical_qualification: USER-SPECIFIED theorem qualification: every complete 30-s MOVING window has gravity-direction span >=2 deg
attitude_excitation.transition_scope: one carried physical episode; no boundary reselection at proof words; finite detector delay and recurring bridge retention remain OPEN

displacement_excitation.rule: for every physical moving episode I and every complete window W of duration T_P contained in closure(I): sup_{s,u in W} ||p(s)-p(u)|| >= P_E > 0; windows crossing physical rest boundaries belong to transition; isolated zero-rate instants do not split moving episodes
displacement_excitation.numerical_qualification: USER-SPECIFIED theorem qualification: every complete 30-s MOVING window has wave-displacement span >=0.03 m
displacement_excitation.transition_scope: same carried physical wave coordinate and primitive; no boundary or proof-word reselection

imu_bias.temporal_rule: On the calibrated delivered-sample hold, every placed window of length 0<T<=H_i has norm of signed integral <= min(B_i_f*T,C_i); finite H_i>0 and C_i<B_i_f*H_i. Longer intervals use the carried history, not a reset.
imu_bias.assembled_two_timescale_qualification: USER-SPECIFIED candidate assembled-device FAST qualification; analytical theorem use conditional on actual delivered-device validation

qualification.B_a_s: Inherited candidate sqrt(3)*0.13. The old prose calls 0.13 a commissioned per-axis residual envelope; no attached assembled-device record establishing this slow-component bound was found. Not a fit-uncertainty or sensor-noise sigma.
qualification.D_a_s: Inherited selected deterministic deployment limit, not a measured bias-rate specification. Assembled slow-history qualification OPEN.
qualification.B_g_s: Inherited 0.02 norm envelope; previous commissioned wording has no linked assembled slow-component evidence. Candidate only.
qualification.D_g_s: Inherited 1e-5 rate envelope; no linked time-record qualification found. Candidate only, not estimator process noise.
qualification.B_a_f: Inherited 0.3 instantaneous proof envelope, not a broadband RMS-to-pathwise conversion. Two-timescale decomposition qualification OPEN.
qualification.B_g_f: Inherited 0.02 instantaneous proof envelope, not the gyro sigma or noise density. Two-timescale decomposition qualification OPEN.
qualification.fast_temporal: USER-SPECIFIED candidate: H_a=60 s,C_a=.05 m/s,H_g=60 s,C_g=.002 rad; hardware validation remains required

magnetic_service.qualification: selected certification limits; source-uniform accepted informative service is open

sensor_model.qualification: Existing timing, Racc and detector-band limits retained numerically. The detector-band RMS envelope is a separate proof qualification of the actual frontend, not implied by a new fast-component amplitude or by an RMS-to-pathwise conversion. Assembled qualification remains OPEN.

a21_schedule.qualification: literal shipping clamps/cadence; 16 s subword closes translation while 2048 disjoint one-second MAGNETIC SERVICE windows accumulate weak transverse gyro-bias information without a long-horizon rotation assumption

a21_retained_domain.qualification: strict tilt proof domain plus universal literal projection-sector bias bound; projection-inactive release is not assumed
